```{r libraries}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(deeptime)
technology_palette <- c(
  "ONT dRNA" = "#56B4E9",  # Soft Blue
  "ONT cDNA" = "#4A5899",  # Sandy gold
  "Iso-Seq"   = "#EE7B30",  # Orange
  "Kinnex"   = "#e31c93"   # PacBio pink
)
lab_text_palette <- c(
  "ONT dRNA" = "#FFFFFF",  # Soft Blue
  "ONT cDNA" = "#FFFFFF",  # Deep Blue
  "Iso-Seq"   = "#FFFFFF",  # Soft Orange
  "Kinnex"   = "#FFFFFF",   # Vermilion/Orange-Red
  "Bambu" = "#000000",
  "flair" = "#000000",
  "isoquant" =  "#000000",

```

```{r load_data}
read_dataset <- function(manifest_file, dataset){
  input_files <- read.delim(manifest_file, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  l_files_all <- list()
  for (i in 1:nrow(input_files)){
    input_path <- input_files[i,1]
    technology <- input_files[i,2]
    df <- read.csv(input_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df$dataset <- dataset
    df$technology <- gsub("_", " ", technology) # Replace technical underscores with clean spaces
    df_all <- df %>% 
      filter(LengthQuantile == "All")
    l_files_all[[input_path]] <- df_all
  }
  
  all_data <- do.call(rbind, l_files_all)
  
  return(all_data)
}

datasets <- c("NIH", "Neuron", "LongBench")
l_data_trans <- list()
for (dataset in datasets){
  manifest_file <- paste0("data/sirv_trans_", dataset, ".fofn")
  l_data_trans[[dataset]] <- read_dataset(manifest_file, dataset)
}
all_trans <- do.call(rbind, l_data_trans)
all_trans$dataset[all_trans$dataset == "NIH"] <- "Mouse"

# Update datasets for plotting
datasets <- c("Mouse", "Neuron", "LongBench")

# Rename ratio_correction to ratio_counts for consistency with Figure 4
all_trans$Normalization[all_trans$Normalization == "ratio_correction"] <- "ratio_counts"
all_trans$Normalization <- factor(all_trans$Normalization, levels = c("CPM", "TPM", "cqn", "EDA", "ratio_counts"))

# recompute NRMSE and similarity after deaing with floating point arithmetics problems
all_trans$mean_expected <- ifelse(abs(all_trans$mean_expected) < 1e-6, 1, all_trans$mean_expected)
all_trans$NRMSE <- all_trans$RMSE / abs(all_trans$mean_expected)
all_trans$Similarity <- 1- all_trans$NRMSE
all_trans <- all_trans %>%
  mutate(
    Tool = case_when(
      Tool == "flair"    ~ "FLAIR",
      Tool == "isoquant" ~ "IsoQuant",
      Tool == "kallisto" ~ "Kallisto",
      Tool == "oarfish"  ~ "Oarfish",
      Tool == "bambu"    ~ "Bambu",
      TRUE               ~ as.character(Tool)
    ),
    Tool = factor(Tool, levels = c("Bambu", "FLAIR", "IsoQuant", "Kallisto", "Oarfish"))
  )

# Clamp non-finite (-Inf from division by zero range) and NA values to 0
all_trans$Similarity[!is.finite(all_trans$Similarity) | is.na(all_trans$Similarity)] <- 0
```

```{r theme_and_colors}
# Swapped colorblind-friendly Normalization Color Palette matching Figure 4
color_palette <- c(
  "CPM" = "#767676",  # Neutral mid grey
  "TPM" = "#33B5A5",  # Professional teal
  "cqn" = "#B64342",  # Publication red
  "EDA" = "#E28E2C",  # Soft gold/orange
  "ratio_counts" = "#7570B3" # Muted purple
)

# Strict Nature-style theme with optimized vertical strip margins to prevent clipping
theme_nature <- function(base_size = 6.5, base_family = "sans") {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.5, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size - 0.3),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.7),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.3, face = "bold"),
      strip.text.y = element_text(size = 5.5, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 2, r = 2, b = 2, l = 2)),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

theme_set(theme_nature())
```

```{r generate_plots}
l_plots <- list()
dataset_titles <- c("Mouse" = "Mouse", "Neuron" = "iNeuron", "LongBench" = "LongBench")
for (my_dataset in datasets){
  l_plots[[my_dataset]] <- all_trans %>% 
    filter(dataset == my_dataset) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = Normalization, y = RMSE, color = Normalization, fill = Normalization)) +
    geom_violin(color = NA, alpha = 0.35, scale = "width", width = 0.6) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Normalization, fill = Normalization), position = position_jitter(width = 0.18, height = 0), size = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
    facet_grid_color(technology ~ Tool, colors = technology_palette, lab_colors = lab_text_palette) + 
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("CPM" = "CPM", "TPM" = "TPM", "cqn" = "CQN", "EDA" = "EDASeq", "ratio_counts" = "SMR")) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = color_palette, 
      guide = "none",
      labels = c("CPM" = "CPM", "TPM" = "TPM", "cqn" = "CQN", "EDA" = "EDASeq", "ratio_counts" = "SMR")
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = color_palette, 
      guide = "none",
      labels = c("CPM" = "CPM", "TPM" = "TPM", "cqn" = "CQN", "EDA" = "EDASeq", "ratio_counts" = "SMR")
    ) +
    labs(x = "", y = "RMSE", title = dataset_titles[my_dataset]) +
    theme_nature() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 5.0))
}
```

```{r assemble}
# Final Figure Assembly: 3 rows, single-column transcript Similarity facet grids
fig3 <- l_plots$Mouse / l_plots$LongBench / l_plots$Neuron + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") & 
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"), legend.position = "none")
```

```{r export}
# Professional high-impact export function
save_pub_r <- function(plot, filename, width_mm = 180, height_mm = 220, dpi = 600) {
  w <- width_mm / 25.4
  h <- height_mm / 25.4
  
  # Lossless Vector SVG
  svglite::svglite(paste0(filename, ".svg"), width = w, height = h)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
  
  # Vector PDF with embedded fonts
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(paste0(filename, ".pdf"), width = w, height = h, family = "sans")
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
  
  # High-DPI TIFF for publication print
  ragg::agg_tiff(paste0(filename, ".tiff"), width = w, height = h, units = "in", res = dpi)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
  
  # PNG for rapid preview
  ggsave(paste0(filename, ".png"), plot, width = w, height = h, dpi = 150)
}

# Double-column page width, scaled height for 3 datasets stacked
save_pub_r(fig3, "plots/Figure_4", width_mm = 180, height_mm = 240)
```
